My name is Vineet Malhotra, and I am a tech and electronics Enthusiast based in Delhi, NCR. My reviews differ from others because I don't make Sponsored content on my Channel. I buy all the products, test them, and then review/compare them to make videos. My reviews aren't complete without the Uncomfortable Truth or the Pros and cons of products, and that's why I call them tRuE-VieW.

I give buying links to all the products I review, all of which are my affiliate links. Using them for your purchase won't increase the price, but I may get some affiliate commission, which helps us run our YouTube channel without featuring sponsored content.

My Audience is my Super Power. Each of you added to my Subscriber Count is very special and will always be.

Please don't email me with your product-related queries.
